Agent Architect local project tools (Python 3.10+, macOS/Linux).

positional arguments:
  {init,source,put,checkpoint,supersede,context,impact,show,audit}
    init                Create a project; never overwrite an existing one
    source              Capture original material and its provenance
    put                 Validate and atomically save one JSON record or a

    checkpoint          Save progress for a new session
    supersede           Explicitly replace a claim while retaining its history
    context             Retrieve relevant evidence with conflicts/freshness
                        visible
    impact              Find transitive dependents of a record
    show                Read canonical current records
    audit               Check committed history and captured source hashes

options:
